messages:
anika: quick thread on the docs-in-panel work for Dashboard > Routes. scanned the latest build and flagged a few small but impactful inconsistencies.
jared: drop them here, will triage in sprint planning.
marta: prefer bullets so eng can estimate.
anika: 1) Lexicon drift: console labels say 'KV Cache' and some help snippets call it 'key-value cache' while docs use 'KV-store'. Users get different terms in support tickets. Recommend canonical term 'KV cache' and a short redirect note in docs for older phrasing.
jared: agree on 'KV cache' (matches telemetry & metrics). we'll add a doc alias redirect.
anika: 2) Deep anchors: the inline "Examples" link in the docs panel lands at top of page; user expectation is that it goes straight to the 'Routing examples' section. Can we add per-section anchors + small target icon that opens at section?
docs-bot: docs-bot: created ticket RED-UI-842 to add stable anchors for examples, routing-policy, and batching. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/842
marta: UX/accessibility: the target icon must be keyboard focusable and announce the target with aria-label e.g., "Open docs: routing examples". Also include visually-hidden summary at the heading.
anjika???: (oops) ignore that typo ^^
anika: 3) CTA copy: two CTAs exist in the panel: inline text link "Read more" and a primary button "Documentation". both are vague. proposals: change inline link to "See routing examples" when context-rich, and button to "Open docs" for consistency.
jared: prefer action-first copy. agree to context-sensitive inline phrasing + consistent button label.
marta: 4) Focus behavior: when panel opens via keyboard, focus sometimes lands on the body instead of the panel heading on Safari iOS. also ESC closes the overlay in Chrome but not always in Firefox. need a consistent focus trap + return-focus on close.
samir: i'll add cross-browser keyboard acceptance tests. small note: ensure focusable close control is visually distinct and has aria-label.
anika: 5) Mini-glossary: support sees repeated confusion around "Dedicated" vs "Reserved capacity" and "prefetch" vs "prefetching". add a 3-item glossary collapsed by default at bottom of panel; make it a disclosure widget with aria-expanded.
marta: layout: on narrow viewports the panel footer gets cramped if we add glossary + extra buttons. suggestion: collapse footer into a single kebab/overflow menu under 480px; put glossary under that menu.
jared: good call. that avoids visible button bloat.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened PR #611 adding disclosure component and initial glossary content; awaiting review. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/611
anika: acceptance criteria draft: canonical lexicon file updated, anchors exist for key sections, chevron/target icon keyboard accessible with aria-labels, primary button labeled "Open docs", inline links context-aware, focus trap + return-focus working across Chrome/Firefox/Safari, glossary disclosure present and collapsed by default on mobile.
samir: i'll run tests after PR merges and post results here.
marta: timeline: jared to schedule a 20min sync with docs/eng tomorrow; i'll prepare a tiny mock for the footer overflow behavior.
anika: thanks all. please tag this thread when PR#611 and RED-UI-842 have updates. :raised_hands:
thread_summary: Product design review for in-product docs panel on Routes: standardize 'KV cache' term, add stable section anchors and keyboard-focusable target icon, update CTA copy to action-first text, ensure consistent focus trap and ESC behavior across browsers, add collapsed 3-item glossary and mobile footer overflow. docs-bot linked ticket and PR.
